verdict.rationale: The enterprise page lists SSO via OIDC and SAML, SCIM provisioning, and optional self-hosting of the stagewise Cloud, which covers enterprise identity. The custom-providers docs add support for Azure OpenAI, Amazon Bedrock, and Google Vertex AI API styles, so model access can run through cloud platforms. Missing for 10: in-depth setup documentation for SSO/SAML/SCIM beyond a marketing bullet list, details on how cloud-platform credentials (e.g., IAM roles for Bedrock/Vertex) are handled, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the enterprise identity features.
